concept: Buttons that belong together as one named group: apart at the small gap, or joined into one piece with a hairline of the scene between them.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a button group as a grey bordered box with dividers between the buttons
default_to_avoid.kind: button group, toolbar group, segmented actions
default_to_avoid.why_not: a box with dividers adds a frame the glass does not need; Pane joins the buttons themselves with a hairline seam and squared inner corners

derivation.consequence: corners are continuous and nest, so an inner surface's radius is the outer radius minus the padding between them and a pane inside a pane reads as inside it; controls are full pills because they are held in the hand
derivation.form: joined buttons square their inner corners so the piece keeps one outline

derivation.consequence: padding inside a pane is larger than the gap between items in it, so the edge reads as the object's boundary
derivation.form: apart they sit at the small gap; joined, the gap is a hairline that lets the scene show through

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: each button keeps its own focus stop and the group has a name

options: A hairline seam, squared inner corners
C buttons touching with no seam
variants.picked: A hairline seam, squared inner corners
variants.reason: A reads as one object of parts on glass (P3). B frames it twice. C merges the buttons into one blur.

root.why: the buttons sit in a row at the small gap and wrap on a narrow pane

vertical.why: stacked, the buttons fill the column for a side toolbar

attached.why: joined buttons sit in one carved track at an even inset, so the group is one object and every corner nests

data-component.why: a button inside the track gives up its own body and shadow, so the track is the one object

hover.why: a button in the track answers the pointer with the quiet surface, as a segment does

aria-pressed=true.why: a pressed button in the track is chosen glass lit at its top, the way the chosen segment is

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the track keeps a system-colour outline so the group stays one object

--pane-fill-top.why: the chosen fill is two registered colours (R-048), so a change of state fades the glass in on the press's way back up instead of swapping a gradient in one frame

--pane-fill-foot.why: the foot of the same fill moves with its top, so the light across the glass stays one piece mid-change

box-shadow.why: the ring and cast move with the fill, at the same pace, so the edge never lands before the glass

color.why: the label colour moves with the fill so the two never disagree mid-change

transform.why: the press runs at press pace, a reply to the reader
